sentences.en: The law now provides protection for victims of domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 现在法律为家庭暴力的受害者提供了保护。

sentences.en: She left her husband because of the constant domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 因为她遭受了持续的家庭暴力，所以离开了丈夫。

sentences.en: The organization aims to raise awareness about domestic violence and its effects on families.
sentences.zh: 该组织旨在提高人们对家庭暴力及其对家庭影响的认识。
